Q1.rule: photoelectric: 0.002 sigma_ref; pairs: max(0.002 sigma_ref, 1e-6 mu_ref)
Q1.mu_ref: direct XCOM photoelectric + nuclear/electron pair coefficients + analytic free-electron KN
Q1.disclosure: Criterion approved after the two worst near-threshold values were known; no table/grid/interpolation/seed change; Q1(a,b,d,e) saved unchanged.

Q3.rest_convention: escape and unresolved contain kinetic/photon energy; delta_rest = net pair/medium rest change, +2m per pair, -2m per annihilation
Q3.branching_variance_implementation: artificial correlated daughters fed through accumulate_primary, the same primary-closing helper as coupled transport

Q4.radiation_yield_definition: g is the initial charged-particle kinetic-energy-weighted mean radiation yield; NIST mu_en=(1-g)mu_tr
Q4.omitted_process_contributions: model mu_tr components quantified above; NIST binding/fluorescence/triplet recoil and radiative contributions cannot be separated numerically from the bundled coefficient alone

Q5.rule: 5–25 cm; diagnostic only, no expected-behavior gate

Q6.scope: read each backend/energy verdict; not an overall-pass claim
